prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Medium shot. A family of eight seen from behind, their faces never visible, in ankle-length rough undyed wool robes and head-cloths, barefoot, sits close together on straw on a plank floor in the dark, sheep and goats resting around them, all looking up at a thin line of grey daylight above. Dim grey light in deep shadow. Weary and waiting. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
